5 points
A calculator shows locked, with a plain reason ('Unlocks when spending reaches Estimate (2 of 5 there)'), until every item in each group is at or above the level.
income reaches Estimate (every income item at 75+); spending reaches Estimate (every spending item at 75+); an invested balance is in (every invested item at 25+)

Once unlocked: High at a weighted input level of 90 or more, Medium at 75 or more, else Low; any input older than the aged-check days drops it one step. Shown instead of the Guess tag.
Ending a session saves a snapshot with the key numbers and the Picture %: Day 0 the first time, End of session N after. They live in the client file, so they export and import with it.
